what: The world-building caption in play, a Start clicked before the world was built (chunk meshes held 12 s after the browser lock, the lock held at the shot), production build, Chromium new headless on Apple M3 Max (ANGLE Metal), 1280x800 at DPR 2. fg: median of the glyph pixels within RGB distance 48 of the CSS colour. bg/contrast: against the median of a ring 2-6 CSS px outside the text box (the backdrop). edge/edgeContrast: against the median of the non-glyph pixels within 2 device px of a glyph (the outline where there is one); edgeWorst: the 10th percentile of those by luminance closeness (anti-aliased blends and fog between strokes). WCAG 2 relative luminance.
